args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; fixed in 2.9.4.

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity).

## Details
- CVE-2026-31337: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in fastjson < 2.9.4.
- Fixed in 2.9.4 (also 3.1.0); this PR takes the minimal, in-bounds upgrade to 2.9.4.
- Change: `requirements.txt` pin `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`.
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.

## Notes
Merging requires approval from a code owner; requesting review from alex.
